rationale: The MIN-of-ranks construction faithfully encodes the "both elevated" hypothesis and is not a direct rediscovery, but it is a fairly crude bolting-together of two well-known characteristics (Sloan accruals, book leverage) whose standalone signs are already documented, so incremental information content is uncertain.

The conditional design is internally consistent, but zeroing out all non-deficit firms creates a large point mass at zero that will make extreme portfolios thin and unstable, and the short leg will be populated by liquidity-deficit firms with *negative* accruals — meaning the spread may proxy the working-capital-deficit/distress effect rather than accrual quality.

This is a single-theme rescaling, not a cross-theme interaction, and because `che` can be arbitrarily small the cross-sectional ranking will be dominated by 1/cash (a known cash-holdings effect) rather than earnings quality, with the sign flipping incoherently for the many firms with negative accruals and thin cash.

Sign logic is coherent (a non-negative rank weight scales but never flips the signed accrual change), yet the rank multiplier only attenuates rather than conditions, and DELTA of an accrual ratio is a second difference of working capital that is likely to be dominated by noise, so the "joint deterioration" mechanism is only weakly encoded.

Structurally near-identical to Liquidity-Crisis Accruals (accruals × distress indicator) and worse identified: among loss firms `ib-oancf` is typically strongly negative, so the extreme-low portfolio will be loss firms and the extreme-high portfolio will be the zero-mass of profitable firms, making the spread a repackaged profitability/loss anomaly rather than a test of accrual persistence.

The base term is correctly implemented Sloan (1996) balance-sheet accruals — on its own a rediscovery — but the retained-earnings-deficit weighting is an economically motivated, sign-consistent conditioning variable with full-sample coverage, making this the best-constructed proposal in a batch that is otherwise monotonously accruals-times-distress.
